title: Rav Chinena son of Rav Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 110a, saying that asparagus [drink] combines [with the cups] for good. Hyman reports the Dikdukei Soferim reading as Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The matching William Davidson digital passage is Pesachim 110b and writes Rav Chinena son of Rabbi Yehoshua. Hyman supplies 110a and fully writes Rav before the father’s name; his alternative Huna son of Rav Yehoshua is preserved as his report.

The whole Davidson Pesachim 110b paragraph has Rav Chinena son of Rabbi Yehoshua and the statement about asparagus combining for good. Hyman’s supplied 110a and fully written Rav before the father’s name are retained. His Dikdukei Soferim alternative remains an attributed report, with the father’s name expanded contextually from his own full heading, not a fresh apparatus collation or father-identity binding.
